title: Global $+$-regularity of regular del Pezzo surfaces in mixed characteristic
summary: Let $R = W(k)$ be the ring of Witt vectors over an algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic $p > 2$. Let $M$ be a three-dimensional regular integral flat projective $R$-scheme such that $H^0(M,\mathcal{O}_M) = R$ and the anticanonical sheaf $ω_M^{-1}$ is ample. We show that $M$ is globally $+$-regular if the closed fiber $M_k$ is reduced.
